response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile), m AS (SELECT weathprofile, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, AVG(avg_bandusagepct) OVER () AS mean_of_avgs FROM g) SELECT weathprofile, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, avg_bandusagepct - mean_of_avgs AS diff_from_mean FROM m WHERE mean_of_avgs IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes with a NULL weathprofile (from a matched observatory) form their own group and count toward the mean of per-profile averages. Telescopes with NULL detecttempk are excluded by the threshold filter.
telescope_count counts all qualifying telescopes in the profile, including those with NULL bandusagepct.
